name: v6-cohort-builder-py
description: Generates a cohort from an ATLAS cohort definition (Circe JSON) or OHDSI SQL in each node's OMOP CDM database and returns the subject count per node. Run generate_cohort (data extraction), then central_function (or cohort_count) on the dataframe it leaves in the session. Counts below a node's minimum are withheld.

functions.name: generate_cohort
functions.description: Generate a cohort in this node's OMOP database and leave its subject count in the session.

arguments.name: sql
arguments.description: OHDSI CohortGenerator SQL. Provide exactly one of sql or atlas_json. Only nodes that set COHORT_BUILDER_ALLOW_SQL: true accept it.

arguments.name: atlas_json
arguments.description: ATLAS cohort expression (Circe JSON). Provide exactly one of sql or atlas_json.

arguments.name: cohort_id
arguments.description: Positive cohort identifier. Generated from the current time if omitted; use the same id at every node.

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.description: Replace an existing cohort with the same id instead of failing.

databases.name: omop
databases.description: The node's OMOP CDM database. Its env settings must give DBMS, USER, PASSWORD, CDM_DATABASE, CDM_SCHEMA and RESULTS_SCHEMA.

functions.name: central_function
functions.description: Add up the cohort counts generate_cohort recorded at each node, with a range when a node withheld a count below its minimum.

arguments.name: organizations_to_include
arguments.description: Organizations to ask. Defaults to every organization in the collaboration.

databases.name: cohort
databases.description: The dataframe generate_cohort left in the session; the node subtasks read it.

functions.name: cohort_count
functions.description: Return the cohort outcome generate_cohort recorded at this node: status, cohort id and subject count, or below_minimum when the count is withheld.

databases.name: cohort
databases.description: The one-row dataframe generate_cohort left in the session.
